title: Calibration Range Recorder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Set the raw position of one joint at its middle pose and at the two ends of its sweep, and see the homing offset, the recorded range and its width in degrees. Then predict the result of a calibration run in six situations. Used in Chapter 8.

educational.topic: The two steps of calibration: homing offset and range of motion limits
learningObjectives: Infer the result of a calibration run from a description of what the builder did in each of its two steps, in six situations, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Trace which stored number a change in the procedure affects, commit to a result, then read the reason
keyQuestions: Which stored number does this action change: the offset or a range limit?
What does the program do when a joint never moved?
commonMisconceptions: The homing position is the arm's resting pose
The calibrated range is the range the servo can physically turn
A calibration file stays right forever
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed choices from five results, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: a / b / c / d / e (the five results)
